title: Grilled Gosari with Fernbrake Sauce
description: A French-inspired dish featuring grilled gosari with a tangy fernbrake sauce. Perfect for a light meal or snack.
instructions: Rinse the gosari and pat dry with paper towels.
Brush the gosari with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the gosari for 2-3 minutes per side, or until tender.
Meanwhile, combine fernbrake, garlic, and lemon juice in a blender.
Blend the mixture until smooth and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve the grilled gosari with the fernbrake sauce.
Garnish with additional fernbrake if desired.
